invariant_bindings.invariant_text: apply MUST be deterministic: given the same event stream in the same order, the view state SHALL converge to the same contents.
The view CANNOT be the system of record; rebuild MUST be able to regenerate state purely from the source feed.
Reads against the view MUST tolerate bounded staleness and NEVER claim linearizability with the base data.
Schema evolution SHALL trigger a rebuild path; silent backfill with stale rows is FORBIDDEN.
New projections extend MaterializedView by registering handlers per aggregate type; unknown event types MUST be rejected rather than silently dropped.
